headline: Zensar Technologies Reports 4.1% Sequential Constant Currency Revenue Growth
summary: Zensar Technologies announced consolidated financial results for the second quarter of fiscal 2026-2027, registering 4.1% sequential constant currency revenue growth.
why: Zensar Technologies is an IT services and solutions provider, and quarterly revenue figures offer insight into sector demand and company execution.
